config_name: iPad Air 11-inch — M4 8-core CPU / 9-core GPU, 12GB RAM, 256GB SSD, 11" Liquid Retina + Magic Keyboard

specs.display_type: Liquid Retina IPS LCD (fully laminated, anti-reflective, no ProMotion)
specs.ports: 1x USB-C (USB 3 10Gb/s, DisplayPort), magnetic Magic Keyboard connector, Smart Connector
specs.keyboard_notes: Magic Keyboard for iPad Air 11" included in price: scissor keys with full function row (unlit), glass trackpad, cantilever hinge
specs.pen_support: Apple Pencil Pro +$168.99 (BBY sale; ~$199 Apple) — not included in total; Pencil USB-C +$99; hover supported

battery.notes: 28.93Wh cell. Apple claims 10h web/video Wi-Fi (9h cellular); users report ~8h mixed real-world use on the 11".

price.notes: Tablet-only $1,149.00 (apple.com/ca, verified 2026-11-24) + Magic Keyboard Air 11" $379.99 (BBY 19204080). BBY sale: tablet $999.99 (reg $1,149.99) → ~$1,380 with keyboard — the line's standout deal. Cellular variant +$200 ($1,349 tablet). Pencil Pro not included.

offers.name: Apple iPad Air M4 11" 256GB with Wi-Fi 7 (8th Generation) - Space Grey

reviews.quote: The fiercest competitor for the iPad Pro is home-made. Pros: brute top performance, WiFi very fast, high-quality unibody chassis, USB-C with 10 GBit/s, two external displays possible, good color accuracy (PWM-free), well-balanced speakers, high recycled content. Cons: slow 60 Hz display, battery charging takes time, SoC throttles under sustained load. (NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026; 11" shares SoC and chassis design.)

praises: The value pick of the whole iPad lineup at BBY sale: M4 + 12GB + 256GB, ~$1,380 with keyboard (r/ipad deal threads)
464g tablet + keyboard under 1kg total — real laptop-class speed that vanishes in a backpack
256GB finally feels adequate for pro apps plus a media library without an external SSD
Function-row Magic Keyboard with glass trackpad makes it a genuine writing machine
Silent fanless M4 that still outruns most mid-range ultrabooks in single-core bursts
complaints: 60Hz — Apple's most defended cut: every sibling phone and the Pro are smoother
500-nit LCD is the dimmest Air panel; outdoor readability suffers vs the 13"'s 600 nits
Unlit keyboard keys at $379.99 accessory price
Single USB-C port (10Gb/s, no Thunderbolt) means a dock for anything serious
iPadOS multitasking and app ceiling still frustrate power users at any price

design_philosophy: The 11" 256GB is the config most reviewers mean by 'the Air for most people': the full M4/12GB machine at the capacity where the device stops feeling cramped, at the smallest size Apple currently sells it in. Retail sales regularly drop the tablet to $999.99, making it the best price-to-capability point in the whole iPad range.
rating_notes: Pro score attached from NBC review of the iPad Air 13" M4 2026 (87%, gap-fill 2026-11-24). Ratings inferred from the 13" M4 256GB line anchor (SHARED-ipad-air.md): 11" deltas screen_size 6.0, portability 9.4, battery 7.8, readability_bright 7.3, keyboard_trackpad 7.9. No verbatim pro score found (bot-walls) — disclosed, none invented. Ecosystem 6.5 per tablets rule. BBY CDN image is this SKU (19788341).
standouts: Best price-to-capability iPad in Canada, especially at BBY's ~$999.99 tablet sale price
Sub-1kg complete laptop-ish setup (464g tablet + Magic Keyboard)
dealbreakers: If 120Hz/OLED matter to you, no Air qualifies — that's the Pro line
